items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Of course everybody in that band was a good musician. Like Pete Bocage (Roche?).

ctx.x: He'd got a good ear then.
Yes, he must have had an ear.
Naturally Piron (Roth?) had the violin and give him those little (parts?) and things like that. Of course everybody in that band was a good musician. Like Pete Bocage (Roche?).
